title: Great and pretty App!!😍🥰
body:
This App is very pretty and I fully recommend Habit Hearts.🩷

Habit Hearts is a delightful habit-tracking app that seamlessly blends functionality with aesthetic appeal. Creating and managing habits is effortless, thanks to the intuitive interface that allows to check off tasks with a simple tap. The app offers elegant charts, friendly reminders, and a selection of lovely icons to personalize each habit. With iCloud synchronization and no sign-in requirements, Habit Hearts ensures a user-friendly experience. Whether you're aiming to drink more water, exercise regularly, read daily, or meditate, this app provides a beautiful and effective platform to cultivate and maintain positive habits.
author: samsarasam

title: J’adore
body:
Très bonne application! Je l’utilise depuis une semaine et j’apprécie de noter mes habitudes quotidiennes ainsi que de voir les cœurs se remplir. 
Le design est très agréable et très joli. L’utilisation est simple et intuitive. Je recommande à toute personne voulant instaurer de bonnes habitudes
author: LauraBloomself
